s.n: Dude ranch brisket sliders with slaw
s.how: Rub 1kg beef brisket with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred with two forks and stir through 150ml barbecue sauce and the juices. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 slider buns with brisket and slaw.

s.note: the guys' life back in the city
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 150g cream cheese and top with 150g smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill. A little taste of home for the city boys.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves, a tin of tomatoes and a tin of kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with a skillet of cornbread.

w.note: sitting under the stars with the herd
w.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.

d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil with a cinnamon stick and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then take off the heat and splash in 100ml cold water to settle the grounds. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp ground cinnamon until soft peaks. Pour the coffee carefully into tin mugs, leaving the grounds behind, and top each with a spoon of the cream.
